N-add13#1.zh: 叫晁盖出来！告诉他我『青面兽』杨志找他！
N-add13#1.t: Tell Chao Gai to come out! Tell him I, 'Blue-faced Beast' Yang Zhi, want him!

N-add13#2.zh: 哦～好狂的口气，想见晁保正先把我给打倒吧！
N-add13#2.t: Oh~ what big talk. If you want to see Headman Chao, beat me first!

N-add13#3.zh: 晁保正岂是你说见就见的？庄上有三位教头，你一个一个赢过来再说！
N-add13#3.t: Do you think you can see Headman Chao just by asking? The manor has three instructors. Beat them one by one, then we'll talk!

N-add13#4.zh: 不过庄上有庄上的规矩：比三阵，你们每阵只许出一个人。第一阵我一个人陪你，第二阵两位师兄弟一起上，第三阵三个一起上，旁人不许插手。三阵全赢了，保正自会出来见你！
N-add13#4.t: But the manor has its rules: three bouts, and you may send only one man each bout. In the first I face you alone, in the second two of us brothers together, in the third all three of us, and no one else interferes. Win all three and the Headman will come out to see you himself!

N-add13#6.zh: 兄弟们都在庄门外看着，谁也别插手，免得落人口实。
N-add13#6.t: Brothers, watch from outside the gate. Nobody interfere, so they've nothing to hold against us.

N-add13#7.zh: 庄客、家人在院子两边围看，众好汉在庄门外观战。三阵各派一位好汉上场，教头一阵比一阵多；谁体力先剩不到三成谁认输，点到为止；杨志是叫阵的人，三阵里要出战一阵。
N-add13#7.t: Farmhands and household watch from both sides of the yard; the heroes watch from outside the manor gate. Send one hero into each of the three bouts, with one more instructor each time. Whoever first drops below 30% HP gives up; it stops at first blood. Yang Zhi issued the challenge, so he must fight one of the three bouts.

N-add13#9.zh: 胜利条件   --- 第一阵：出战的好汉单挑一个教头，把他打到体力不到三成他就认输（三阵全胜，晁盖才出庄）
N-add13#9.t: Victory --- Bout 1: your hero faces one instructor alone; bring him below 30% HP and he gives up (win all three bouts and Chao Gai comes out)

N-add13#11.zh: 失败条件二 --- 杨志死亡

N-add13#12.zh: 注意       --- 好汉体力不到三成就输了这一阵；输掉一阵、对庄客家人或还没上场的教头出手、拖过第 20 回合，都会翻脸混战，那时要打败所有敌人
N-add13#12.t: Note       --- A hero below 30% HP loses the bout. Losing a bout, attacking farmhands, household or instructors not yet in the bout, or going past turn 20 turns it into a brawl, and then you must defeat all enemies

N-add13#13.zh: 请选择出战第一阵的好汉
N-add13#13.t: Choose the hero for the first bout

N-add13#14.zh: 限制回合数已到，未完成任务，游戏失败！

N-add13#15.zh: %N死亡后，众人眼见生辰纲无法夺回，于是一哄而散，浪迹天涯，不知所终........
N-add13#15.t: With %N dead, the others saw the birthday gifts could not be recovered, scattered, and wandered the world, never heard of again........

N-add13#16.zh: 生辰纲无法取回，%N与众人也不敌庄客围攻，晁盖将众人杀害之后，毁尸灭迹，世上再也无人得知生辰纲下落........
N-add13#16.t: The birthday gifts could not be recovered, and %N and the others could not withstand the farmhands. Chao Gai had them all killed and the bodies destroyed, and no one in the world ever learned where the birthday gifts went........

N-add13#17.zh: 庄客、家人、教头都被打翻在地。庄门里一声大喝，一条大汉大步走了出来。
N-add13#17.t: Farmhands, household and instructors all lay knocked flat. A great shout came from inside the gate, and a big man strode out.

N-add13#19.zh: 哼，输了还不快滚？三阵都赢不下来，也配见保正？
N-add13#19.t: Hmph, you lost, so get out of here. Can't win three bouts and you think you deserve to see the Headman?

N-add13#20.zh: 胜败乃兵家常事。今日见不着晁盖，杨志绝不罢休！
N-add13#20.t: Victory and defeat are a soldier's lot. Until I see Chao Gai today, I, Yang Zhi, won't let this go!

N-add13#21.zh: 原来是存心来闹事的。庄客们，把这伙人统统拿下！
N-add13#21.t: So you came looking for trouble. Farmhands, seize the lot of them!

N-add13#22.zh: 兄弟们，抄家伙！打进庄去，找晁盖讨回生辰纲！
N-add13#22.t: Brothers, grab your weapons! Fight into the manor and get the birthday gifts back from Chao Gai!

N-add13#23.zh: 庄客、家人四面合围，一场混战！
N-add13#23.t: Farmhands and household close in from all sides. A free-for-all!

N-add13#25.zh: 胜利条件   --- 打败所有敌人

N-add13#27.zh: 失败条件二 --- 杨志死亡

N-add13#28.zh: 说好了一对一，你们竟敢对旁人下手！
N-add13#28.t: We agreed one on one, and you dare attack bystanders!

N-add13#29.zh: 这伙人不讲规矩，大伙儿一起上！
N-add13#29.t: This lot don't follow the rules. Everyone at them!

N-add13#30.zh: 罢了，横竖要见晁盖，那就打进去！
N-add13#30.t: Fine. We have to see Chao Gai either way, so we'll fight our way in!

N-add13#31.zh: 庄客、家人四面合围，一场混战！
N-add13#31.t: Farmhands and household close in from all sides. A free-for-all!

N-add13#33.zh: 胜利条件   --- 打败所有敌人

N-add13#35.zh: 失败条件二 --- 杨志死亡

N-add13#36.zh: 磨磨蹭蹭，比到天黑也比不完！
N-add13#36.t: Dawdling like this, we'll still be at it after dark!

N-add13#37.zh: 别比了！一起上，把这伙人拿下送官！
N-add13#37.t: Enough bouts! Everyone at once, seize this lot and hand them to the officials!

N-add13#38.zh: 来得好！兄弟们，并肩子上！
N-add13#38.t: Bring it on! Brothers, shoulder to shoulder!

N-add13#39.zh: 庄客、家人四面合围，一场混战！
N-add13#39.t: Farmhands and household close in from all sides. A free-for-all!

N-add13#41.zh: 胜利条件   --- 打败所有敌人

N-add13#43.zh: 失败条件二 --- 杨志死亡

N-add13#44.zh: 好厉害……这一阵是我输了。

N-add13#45.zh: 可恶！师父传的棍棒，竟没占到便宜……
N-add13#45.t: Damn! My master's staff work, and it got me nowhere...

N-add13#46.zh: 朱武本不以武艺见长，这一阵认输。
N-add13#46.t: Zhu Wu was never known for martial skill. He concedes this bout.

N-add13#47.t: Ow! Good grief, I can't beat him...

N-add13#49.zh: 林冲做了半辈子教头，今日倒输给了庄上的教头……
N-add13#49.t: Half a lifetime as an instructor, and today Lin Chong loses to the manor's instructors...

N-add13#50.t: Enough! This bout... Yang Zhi loses.

N-add13#51.zh: 哇呀呀，洒家竟输了这一阵！
N-add13#51.t: Waaah, I actually lost this bout!

N-add13#52.zh: 好身手！这一阵算我输了。
N-add13#52.t: Fine skill! I'll count this bout as lost.

N-add13#53.zh: 好家伙，以一敌二……我认输。
N-add13#53.t: Good grief, one against two... I give up.

N-add13#54.zh: 师兄都退下了，我也认了。
N-add13#54.t: My brother has stepped back, so I concede too.

N-add13#56.t: Skill like that, I submit too.

N-add13#57.t: What a man! We all submit.

N-add13#59.t: One against two, the second bout is won too!

N-add13#60.zh: 以一敌三，三阵全胜！庄门大开，一条大汉大步走了出来，正是『托塔天王』晁盖。
N-add13#60.t: One against three, all three bouts won! The manor gate swung open and a big man strode out: 'Pagoda King' Chao Gai himself.

N-add13#61.zh: 连胜三阵，『托塔天王』晁盖亲自出庄。
N-add13#61.t: Three bouts won in a row; 'Pagoda King' Chao Gai comes out of the manor himself.

N-add13#62.zh: 第一阵算你们侥幸。第二阵，我们师兄弟两个一起来！
N-add13#62.t: The first bout was luck. In the second, two of us brothers will face you together!

N-add13#63.zh: 请选择出战第二阵的好汉（对两个教头）
N-add13#63.t: Choose the hero for the second bout (against two instructors)

N-add13#64.zh: 让开！第三阵，我们三个一起会会你！
N-add13#64.t: Out of the way! In the third bout, all three of us will take you on!

N-add13#65.zh: 请选择出战第三阵的好汉（对三个教头）
N-add13#65.t: Choose the hero for the third bout (against three instructors)

N-add13#67.zh: 胜利条件   --- 第二阵：另派一位好汉，以一敌二，把两个教头都打到体力不到三成
N-add13#67.t: Victory --- Bout 2: send another hero, one against two; bring both instructors below 30% HP

N-add13#69.zh: 失败条件二 --- 杨志死亡

N-add13#70.t: Note       --- A hero below 30% HP loses the bout. Losing a bout, attacking farmhands, household or instructors not yet in the bout, or going past turn 20 turns it into a brawl, and then you must defeat all enemies

N-add13#72.zh: 胜利条件   --- 第三阵：再派一位好汉，以一敌三，把三个教头都打到体力不到三成
N-add13#72.t: Victory --- Bout 3: send another hero, one against three; bring all three instructors below 30% HP
